description: This file contains unit tests for the SendFeatureMessageResponse class in the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically testing validation logic related to feature IDs in message headers.

classes.name: SendFeatureMessageResponseTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing SendFeatureMessageResponse behavior in handling message feature IDs.

methods.name: validatesThatFeatureIDIsPresentInMessageHeaders
methods.description: Tests that an exception is thrown when the message lacks a feature ID in headers.

methods.name: validatesThatFeatureIDIsEqualInHeadersAndWrappingCommand
methods.description: Tests that an exception is thrown when the feature ID in the message headers does not match the expected feature ID.

methods.name: instantiatingAFeatureMessageResponseWorksWithEqualFeatureIds
methods.description: Tests that creating a SendFeatureMessageResponse with matching feature IDs does not throw an exception.
